time_independent_schrodinger.validation: Energy levels match analytical: E_n = ℏω(n + 1/2)

time_dependent_schrodinger.validation: Total energy conserved to 1e-6; probability preserved (∫|ψ|²=1)

normalization.validation: Normalized wavefunction satisfies ∫|ψ|²=1 to machine precision

rectangular_barrier_transmission.description: Transmission probability through a rectangular barrier for E < V0 (ħ = m = 1)
rectangular_barrier_transmission.validation: Matches the plane-wave matching solve to 1e-9; T + R = 1

wkb_tunneling.description: WKB estimate of tunneling through a thick barrier
wkb_tunneling.validation: Agrees with the closed form to 2% for κa = 6

double_slit_fringe_spacing.description: Fringe spacing of the far-field two-slit pattern, with de Broglie wavelength
double_slit_fringe_spacing.validation: Measured spacing matches λL/d for a narrow slit

double_slit_intensity.latex: I(y) = I_0 \mathrm{sinc}^2\left(\frac{\pi w y}{\lambda L}\right)\cos^2\left(\frac{\pi d y}{\lambda L}\right)
double_slit_intensity.description: Far-field two-slit intensity: single-slit envelope times the double-slit interference term
double_slit_intensity.validation: Central maximum is I_0; envelope vanishes at y = λL/w; visibility 1 for a narrow slit
